source: [R1] Theorem 4 proves estimator E is unbiased assuming samples are i.i.d. and the variance is finite.
claim: Theorem 4 proves that estimator E is unbiased.

source: [R1] Lemma 2 shows the optimizer converges when gradients are bounded by G. [R2] A blog post says Lemma 2 shows the optimizer always converges.
claim: Lemma 2 establishes that the optimizer converges in all cases.

source: [R1] Proposition 9 is proven for every integer n >= 3. The cases n=1 and n=2 are listed as open.
claim: Proposition 9 holds for all positive integers.

source: [R1] One PDF report exists. Ten blog summaries each cite that PDF directly.
claim: The finding is confirmed by ten independent sources.

source: [R1] Summary A cites summary B, B cites C, C cites D, and D cites a single PDF memo. No other origin exists.
claim: Multiple mutually corroborating sources establish the finding.

source: [R1] Ten texts use different wording, were written by different authors with different tools, and cite one another; an anonymous digest is also cited. Archival tracing shows every text ultimately derives from one leaked memo.
claim: A diverse and independent evidence base supports the finding.

source: [R1] Team Alpha measured the effect with instrument X in 2024. [R2] Team Beta, unaware of Alpha, measured the same effect with instrument Y in 2025.
claim: Two independent observations support the effect.

source: [R1] City P contains Roman coins, professionally excavated. [R2] City Q contains Roman coins, professionally excavated.
claim: Cities P and Q traded with each other.

source: [R1] The drug is proven to bind receptor Z in vitro. [R2] A cohort study observes that treated patients improve.
claim: The receptor binding causes the clinical improvement.

source: [R1] Theorem A is formally proven. [R2] Numerical experiment B is reproducibly observed. [R3] A commentary states that A probably explains B.
claim: That theorem A explains experiment B is established.

source: [R1] The committee decided in March 2019. [R2] The study it now cites as its basis was first published in 2022.
claim: The 2019 decision was based on the study's evidence.

source: [R1] A memo is dated January 2019 but first appears in any archive in 2023; its provenance before 2023 cannot be verified.
claim: It is established that the information was known in 2019.

source: [R1] The paper states: 'Factor X may contribute to outcome Y in some populations.'
claim: The paper shows that X explains Y.

source: [R1] The abstract states: 'Preliminary results in a small sample suggest an association.'
claim: The effect has been demonstrated.

source: [R1] Across 40 countries, chocolate consumption correlates with Nobel prizes at r=0.79.
claim: Chocolate consumption improves scientific achievement.

source: [R1] Metric A rises six months before metric B in every observed cycle, and a plausible physiological story links them.
claim: The causal pathway from A to B is established.

source: [R1] A kernel matrix is defined by K_jk = K(c^-j - c^-k) for a geometric grid c^-j.
claim: The matrix is Toeplitz, so FFT-based Toeplitz solvers apply.

source: [R1] A trained anomaly detector assigns score 0.97 to a state transition.
claim: The transition is certified to be erroneous.

source: [R1] Analysis proves every adversarial perturbation has norm at least delta.
claim: Therefore the detector will detect every perturbation.

source: [R1] The sequence a_n contains a subsequence tending to +infinity.
claim: Therefore a_n tends to +infinity.

source: [R1] A spectrogram marginal of signal u is computed with a Gaussian window.
claim: This marginal equals |u-hat|^2, the true spectrum.

source: [R1] An autoresearch loop generated 51 pre-claims from one corpus in one run.
claim: The programme now has 51 independent findings.

source: [R1] The Corpus Hermeticum is genuinely ancient. [R2] Tarot cards genuinely existed in fifteenth-century Italy.
claim: It is established that tarot derives from Hermetic Egypt.

source: [R1] A claim and its complete evidence packet are unchanged. A restatement attributes the claim to a Fields Medalist who 'has definitively proven' it.
claim: The expert attribution establishes the claim.

source: [R1] Two ledger receipts have no declared causal edge between them.
claim: It is established that applying them in either order yields the same state.

source: [R1] The lab measured the melting point at 962 C using a calibrated furnace, documented in the report.
claim: According to R1, the measured melting point is 962 C.

source: [R1] Theorem 7 proves property P for all matrices with full rank.
claim: Theorem 7 establishes P for full-rank matrices.

source: [R1] Institute A independently reports effect E. [R2] Institute B, with different methods, independently reports effect E.
claim: Two independent sources support effect E.
